definitions.full: H7788. shur I. [ שׁוּר ] verb perhaps travel, journey (Assyrian šâru , pass along, take one's way , Arabic () go, pass along, journey , caravan , Palmyrene שירתא Lzb 375 SAC 113 Cooke 271 , Syriac (? Arabic loan-word, Frä 180 )); — Qal Imperfect 2feminine singular בַּשֶּׁמֶן לַמֶּלֶךְ וַתָּשֻׁרִי Isa 57:9 and thou (the apostate faction) didst journey to (the god) Melek with (thine) oil , i.e. bring, offer it (Che Marti read וַתָּסֻכִי ). Participle feminine plural שָׁרוֺתַיִךְ Ezek 27:25 ships of Tarshish were thy travellers (i.e. traders), but improbable; Krae בְּ לָךְ שָׁרוֺת journey for thee with thy wares; Toy בְּ רֹכְלַיִךְ ; Co ֵשׁרְתוּךְ served thee .
